newsHighlights.title: China names largest overseas Asian Para Games squad
newsHighlights.summary: China has named a 500-member delegation, including 312 athletes, for the fifth Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国组建了500人代表团（含312名运动员），将参加在日本爱知·名古屋举行的第五届亚洲残疾人运动会，为境外参赛规模最大的一次。

newsHighlights.title: Holidays reveal huge appetite for overseas trips
newsHighlights.summary: The holidays revealed a huge appetite for overseas trips as travel and consumption spending stayed vibrant during the break.
newsHighlights.translation: 假期数据显示出境游需求旺盛，旅游与消费支出在假期期间表现活跃。

newsHighlights.title: Gen Z finds a sweet future in hometown's green transition
newsHighlights.summary: Young Chinese are finding a sweet future in their hometown's green transition, blending healthy living with sustainable work.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国年轻人在家乡的绿色转型中找到美好未来，把健康生活与可持续工作结合起来。

newsHighlights.title: 7.2-magnitude earthquake strikes Panama
newsHighlights.summary: A 7.2-magnitude earthquake struck Panama, reminding people of the importance of emergency preparedness and physical readiness.
newsHighlights.translation: 巴拿马发生7.2级地震，提醒人们应急准备与身体应变能力的重要性。

newsHighlights.title: Xi on carrying forward Long March spirit
newsHighlights.summary: This year marks the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Long March, whose arduous journey laid the foundation for later victory.
newsHighlights.translation: 今年是长征胜利90周年，那段艰苦卓绝的征程为后来的胜利奠定了基础。

quote.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
quote.explanation: Emerson 认为，物质财富固然重要，但健康才是一切的基础。正如今天新闻中的残奥运动员与徒步草原的邮递员所示，强健的体魄与坚韧的意志，是追求任何梦想的前提。

pattern.pattern: sb./sth. has done little to ease ... （……对缓解……收效甚微）
pattern.example: A US ban on nearly $1 billion worth of Canadian imports has done little to ease a trade dispute between the two countries.
pattern.translation: 美国对近10亿美元加拿大商品的禁令对缓解两国贸易争端收效甚微。
pattern.usage: 该句型用现在完成时表示“已经做了某事，但到现在为止效果甚微”，常用于客观评价某项措施的成效。可替换宾语：has done little to ease stress / pain / tension。

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）在新闻中的运用
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时结构为 have/has + 过去分词，强调过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或动作从过去持续到现在。新闻英语常用它来报道刚刚发生、且与当前状况密切相关的事情，常与 already, just, yet, so far, recently 等时间状语连用。
examples: China has named a 500-member delegation, including 312 athletes, for the fifth Asian Para Games.
A US ban on nearly $1 billion worth of Canadian imports has done little to ease a trade dispute between the two countries.

pronunciation.tips: 注意：第一个音节是 /ˈæθ/，/θ/ 要咬舌送气；重音在第一音节，第二个音节为轻快的 /liːt/。很多学习者会多读一个元音，读成 a-tha-lete，正确读法只有两个音节 ATH-leet。
examples: The delegation includes 312 athletes from across the country.
Every athlete needs enough rest to stay healthy and strong.

reading.title: What Today's News Teach Us About a Healthy Life
reading.content:
This week's news offers plenty of inspiration for a healthier lifestyle. China has named a 500-member delegation, including 312 athletes, for the fifth Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya. These athletes remind us that regular training and a positive attitude matter far more than physical perfection.

At the same time, the holidays revealed a huge appetite for overseas trips, and travel and consumption spending stayed vibrant during the break. Walking through a new city, hiking across grasslands, or simply breathing fresh air is one of the easiest ways to improve both mood and fitness.

Meanwhile, Gen Z is finding a sweet future in its hometown's green transition, proving that a clean environment supports a healthy body and mind.

You do not need to run a marathon. Start small: take a walk after dinner, sleep well, and eat less sugar. As the Long March story shows, health is built step by step.
reading.translation:
本周的新闻为更健康的生活方式带来了不少启发。中国组建了包括312名运动员在内的500人代表团，出征在爱知·名古屋举行的第五届亚洲残疾人运动会。这些运动员告诉我们：规律训练和积极心态远比身体的完美更重要。

与此同时，假期显示出人们对出境游的强烈需求，假日期间旅游与消费支出保持活跃。漫步一座陌生的城市、穿越草原徒步，或只是呼吸新鲜空气，都是改善情绪与体能最简单的方式。

此外，Z世代在家乡的绿色转型中找到了美好未来，证明了干净的环境有益于身心健康。

你不必去跑马拉松。从小事做起：晚饭后散散步、睡好觉、少吃糖。正如长征的故事所揭示的那样，健康是一步步积累起来的。
reading.sourceNote: 根据 ChinaDaily 2026年10月11日多条真实新闻（Asian Para Games squad、Holidays reveal huge appetite for overseas trips、Gen Z finds a sweet future in hometown's green transition、Xi on carrying forward Long March spirit）改写，用于英语学习。
